notes.title: "Crossroads" DLC now available
notes.content:
---------------------------------------
Features
[list]
[*]Added support for "Crossroads" DLC [i](Head to the mountains south of Aiyun Village)[/i]
[*]Added the option to play with music from "Untold Tales of Citadale" [i](Can be toggled)[/i]
[*]"Crossroads" DLC includes new, exclusive Hunting Quests
[*]Added new Hunting Quests to the Main Game as well
[*]Added a new Side Quest given by Queen Aidenn [i](requires completion of other quests to unlock)[/i]
[*]Added additional details to the interiors of some renovated buildings
[*]Added food items to restaurants [i](food items restore health and give buffs)[/i]
[*]Fixed a bug in the Ancient Cave that prevented puzzle rooms from resetting
[*]Fixed a bug that displayed wrong background colors for some interiors
[*]Fixed a bug that sent players to the wrong location upon exiting a specific ruined house
[*]Fixed a bug that sometimes displayed dialogue on the wrong side of the screen
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented a character from showing up during a cutscene
[/list]
